voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Bennington, Vermont. December first, nineteen forty-six. An eighteen-year-old college student left campus, to go hiking.
She wore a red coat, jeans, and sneakers. Light clothes, for a December night in the mountains.
Around four o'clock, hikers on the Long Trail spoke with her, near Glastenbury Mountain. No one is known to have seen her again.
Hundreds of people searched the woods. No trace of her was ever found.
Vermont had no state police. Her case led to the creation of one, in nineteen forty-seven. What happened to her has never been determined.
